{{Quote|The Empire's mapping and exploration divisions are attached to the Imperial Navy. These frontier scouts help expand the Empire's borders by identifying worlds primed for conquest or exploitation.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]], ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''|<ref name="Imperial Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>}}
The '''Imperial Survey Corps''' (ISC) was a branch of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]], more specifically the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], whose duty was the exploration of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was a sister organization of the [[Imperial Exploration Corps/Legends|Imperial Exploration Corps]], also a branch of the Imperial Navy.<ref name="Imperial Handbook" /> To fulfill its mission, the ISC was often staffed with scientists and [[Scout/Legends|scouts]]; however, it never achieved much importance during the height of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] and thus experienced perennial manpower shortages. The Empire planned to gradually pare back the size of the ISC and eventually disband it altogether<ref name="The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref> due to Emperor [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] inability to control the corps&mdash;many ISC members had spirits too independent for the Empire, and some even ran information and supplies for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="Galaxy Guide 8">''[[Galaxy Guide 8: Scouts]]''</ref> Regardless of the ISC's increasingly reduced status, it was claimed that the corps was responsible for discovering a new planetary system every 207 minutes.<ref name="Imperial Sourcebook">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|Most of these scouts are in it for the adventure and don't know what the Empire does with the data they send back. We've had a lot of defectors from the Survey Corps.|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]], commenting in the ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''|<ref name="Imperial Handbook" />}}
The ISC's preferred scout vessel was the [[MRX-BR Pacifier]], which embodied the mindsets of [[Survey Team|Imperial scouts]] with its powerful weapon systems.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 8" /> However, some crews, such as those under [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Pilia Tonth]], used the [[Far*Reach IV PQR]].

According to the Rebel Alliance [[General/Legends|general]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]], most of the scours were unaware of what the Imperials would do with the data they sent back and were only in it for the adventure, unaware of whatever atrocities or conquests the Empire would conduct using their work. The Alliance received many defectors from the branch as a result.<ref name="Imperial Handbook" />
